systems.system: Fichier national du corps électoral and communal electoral lists
systems.tiers: a copy of each communal list, 'en format papier ou numérique', deposited with the court registry and the Authority (art. 71 as amended, 4 April 2026); the Authority has a coordinator in every commune

note: Journal officiel n° 24 of 4 April 2026: the electoral-law reform, credit transfers and appointments. Communes appear as electoral units and as seats of commissions, which IT technicians named by the wali assist; a law places nothing, and it says nothing of commune offices' connection.
